claim.quote: We report the observation of a steepening in the cosmic ray energy spectrum of heavy primary particles at about $8 \times 10^{16}$ eV.

date.note: arXiv v1 date; published in Phys. Rev. Lett. 107, 171104 (2011).

key_value.note: Energy of the steepening in the heavy-primary spectrum ("about").

name: Kneelike structure in the heavy-component spectrum

official_url.quote: Kneelike structure in the spectrum of the heavy component of cosmic rays observed with KASCADE-Grande

summary.plain: KASCADE-Grande saw a second bend in the cosmic-ray spectrum at about 8 × 10¹⁶ eV, caused by heavy nuclei running out, much as the first knee at a few PeV marks the end of the light ones.
summary.technical: Independent measurements of charged-particle and muon numbers of air showers (10^16-10^18 eV), analysed event by event with their correlation, show a steepening of the heavy-primary spectrum at about 8 × 10¹⁶ eV; weaker in the all-particle spectrum.

title: Kneelike structure in the spectrum of the heavy component of cosmic rays observed with KASCADE-Grande
why_it_matters: The abstract says that, whereas the knee at 3-5 × 10¹⁵ eV was assigned to light primaries by KASCADE, the new structure found by KASCADE-Grande is caused by heavy primaries.
